tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to your café!
tutorial.welcome.text: Your guests buy matcha and bring in coins. Spend coins to grow your café – then more guests come and pay more.
tutorial.upgrade.title: Upgrade the matcha bar
tutorial.upgrade.text: Open the shop (blue cart) and upgrade the matcha bar to level 3. You can also tap the bar in the café directly.
tutorial.station.title: A new station
tutorial.station.text: Buy the checkout in the shop. It takes payments faster, so you serve more guests per second.
tutorial.staff.title: Hire staff
tutorial.staff.text: Open staff and hire someone. Baristas work faster, a cleaner keeps the café tidy.
tutorial.satisfaction.title: Happy guests
tutorial.satisfaction.text: The face shows satisfaction. Decor, quality and short waits raise it – happy guests come more often and tip. Tap it for details.
tutorial.bar.title: Your tools
tutorial.bar.text: Bottom: shop, hype bar (tap the café to fill it), marketing, locations and build (ambience). Right: staff, statistics and achievements.
tutorial.offline.title: Even while you’re away
tutorial.offline.text: Your café keeps earning while the game is closed: for up to {hours} hours, at {pct} % of your income. A store manager extends the time.
tutorial.locations.title: The world is waiting
tutorial.locations.text: From café level {level} you can restart your café as a franchise, earn Zen and open in Kyoto – then Tokyo, Seoul, New York and Bali.
